name: doc-read
description: Read a document from the OKF document workspace by path. Optionally pass `section` to read only a `##` heading's body — keeps per-burst context cost down. Returns full OKF markdown when no section is requested; returns `content` + `section_found` when a section is requested. Documents not found return `found: false`.

outputs.body: string? (full markdown body when no section requested)
outputs.okf: string? (serialized OKF document when no section requested)
outputs.section: string? (resolved section heading when section input provided)
outputs.content: string? (section body when section input provided)
outputs.section_found: boolean? (false when the section heading does not exist)
